author: blu
body: One question, for a payload that is going to the board anyway: does clearing CTRL.ASDE change link bring-up on the real I219-V?

author: blu
body: This chapter measures and formats. It does not draw, so it stays clear of the GOP quires and a caller renders the two lines wherever it likes.

author: blu
body: Every arm carries where it stopped, and the line prints it, so a blank row is not a possible outcome. This stage flew once and painted nothing, and nothing is the one reading a board trip cannot use: it named neither a fault nor a stall nor which call was in flight. A row saying "gave up waiting for link" would have been worth the trip.

author: blu
body: ASDE is cleared by masking it out of whatever CTRL already holds rather than by composing a fresh word, so the two arms differ in exactly one bit and in nothing else. A single bit subtracted from an all-ones mask is the complement of that bit.

author: blu
body: The question does not need a completed negotiation. It needs STATUS read after the same settle, twice, one bit apart. So the PHY is kicked exactly as e1000-phy-bring-up kicks it, minus the wait.

author: blu
body: The whole STATUS word goes on the line as well as the decoded fields, so a photograph stays readable against a field this chapter did not think to decode.
